clips.start_words: I would meditate virtually all day long
clips.caption:
He once meditated virtually all day, every day, for seven months straight, living in a cave in the Himalayas. That's not the point where most people stop listening - it's the point where the real teaching starts.

Because once enough is cleared, meditation stops being a session you sit down for. Eating becomes meditation. Driving becomes meditation. Exercising becomes meditation. Watching a movie becomes meditation. Even having sex becomes meditation.

It stops being a technique you practice and becomes a way you live.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to get there.
